'''Takamuku Shrine''' (高向神社) refers to multiple Shinto shrines in Japan.

* {{ill|Takamuku Shrine (Sakai)|ja|高向神社 (坂井市)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Takamuku Shrine (Sakai)|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid}} (たかむくじんじゃ) – Located in [[:en:Sakai City|Sakai City]], {{ill|Fukui Prefecture|en|Fukui Prefecture|qid=Q133879|lt=Fukui Prefecture|1=Fukui Prefecture}}.
* {{ill|Takamuku Shrine (Ise)|ja|高向神社 (伊勢市)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Takamuku Shrine (Ise)|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid}} (たかぶくじんじゃ) – Located in [[:en:Ise City|Ise City]], {{ill|Mie Prefecture|en|Mie Prefecture|qid=Q128196|lt=Mie Prefecture|1=Mie Prefecture}}. Also known as Takamuku Taisha.
* {{ill|Takamuku Shrine (Kawachinagano)|ja|高向神社 (河内長野市)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Takamuku Shrine (Kawachinagano)|qq=}} (たこうじんじゃ) – Located in [[Kawachinagano City]], {{ill|Osaka Prefecture|en|Osaka Prefecture|qid=Q122723|lt=Osaka Prefecture|1=Osaka Prefecture}}.
